headline: China Vanke Seeks Three-Year Bond Extension Amid Deepening Property Crisis
summary: China Vanke is seeking a three-year extension on a 1.2 billion yuan bond payment due on December 15, proposing a partial upfront repayment as the country's property debt crisis deepens.
why: China's property developers carry massive debt loads that pose systemic risks to the domestic financial sector and broader economic growth.

impacts.name: China Vanke
impacts.why: Failing to meet debt obligations and seeking extensions indicates severe liquidity distress.
